notes.title: Blind Touch Demo Major Update - 07/20/2025
notes.notes:
🧭 Choose between three distinct experience:
🟢 Balanced: Visual aids and hints help guide you. Perfect for those who want to enjoy the story and collectibles.

🟡 Challenging: No hints or assists. Minimal visuals, you’ll rely on sound and memory.

🔴 “Realistic”: Near-total darkness. Navigate solely through audio and spatial awareness — the ultimate test!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45496497/35b6764084d19d6f0bf5d09c110f392f553240de.png"]

Thank you for your continued feedback and support. More updates and content are on the way — stay tuned!

notes.title: Blind Touch Demo Patch Notes - 06/12/2025
notes.notes:
Join Discord for discussion and bug report: Discord Server



Thanks to all the players who shared feedback with us!

In this update, we’ve made improvements to mouse and controller sensitivity to help reduce motion sickness and improve overall comfort during gameplay.

✅ Lowered default mouse sensitivity

✅ Increased controller stick sensitivity

✅ Smoother camera motion and limited range of motion

We understand many players want the ability to customize these settings. We're actively working on adding a settings menu, which will be coming in a future update. Stay tuned!

- flygogo

notes.title: 🚀Steam Next Fest: Demo Major Update
notes.notes:
Join Discord for discussion and bug report: Discord Server

Hi everyone, thanks so much for trying out the "Blind Touch" demo! We've been listening closely to your feedback and have just pushed a major update with some important fixes and polish.

🔧 Update Notes

🕒 Adjusted: 
Controlling cane can cause motion sickness as it's tied with the player camera, we now made a separate button to tap the cane!

 Cane control is now a separate button! 

🔊 Improved: 

 Cane is now more stable with better collision detection
 Audio custom cue is on every item
 Park level quality and water shader
 Main menu level selection screen art

🪨 Added: 

 Human, bird and cat!
 Inspect items that have valuable memory to you
 Collapsible objective menu
 Animation: cane unfolding, character falling in dream

Other:

 Visual and performance optimizations
 Localization fixes

We’re continuing to improve the experience leading up to Steam Next Fest, so your feedback is incredibly valuable. If you run into issues or have suggestions, please let us know!

Thanks again for your support — and stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to the Fest!

- Flygogo
